teaser.en: The warm scent of a coast kitchen at breakfast, when *mahamri* are frying, comes largely from cardamom.
teaser.sw: Harufu tamu na ya joto ya jikoni pwani wakati wa kifungua kinywa, mahamri yanapokaangwa, kwa kiasi kikubwa hutokana na iliki.
teaser.dg: Arufu nono ya dzoho ya dzikoni pwani wakati wa chai ya ligundzu, *mahamri* gachikalangwa, inalavywa zaidi ni *cardamom*.

summary.en: Cardamom is an imported spice whose aromatic seed pods flavour many of the coast's best-loved foods. It goes into *mahamri*, *kashata*, *mkate wa kumimina* and spiced tea.
summary.sw: Iliki ni kiungo kinachoagizwa kutoka nje, ambacho maganda yake ya mbegu yenye harufu nzuri hukoleza vyakula vingi vinavyopendwa sana pwani. Hutiwa katika *mahamri*, *kashata*, *mkate wa kumimina* na chai ya viungo.
summary.dg: *Cardamom* ni chitu chinachorehwa kula tsi za kondze, chinachotiywa vyakurya, na makakayage ga tembe genye arufu nono ganapha ladha vyakurya vinji vinavyomendzwa sana pwani. Nkutiywa *mahamri*, *kashata*, *mkate wa kumimina* na chai yenye viungo.

about.en: Cardamom comes from a tall, leafy plant of the ginger family. What reaches the kitchen are the small, pale green, three-sided pods, each holding a cluster of tiny dark, sticky seeds with a strong, sweet, slightly resinous scent.
about.sw: Iliki hutoka kwa mmea mrefu wenye majani mengi wa familia ya tangawizi. Kinachofika jikoni ni maganda madogo ya kijani hafifu yenye pande tatu, kila moja likiwa na kifungu cha mbegu ndogo nyeusi zinazonata, zenye harufu kali, tamu na ya utomvu kidogo.
about.dg: *Cardamom* inalavywa ni mmea mure wenye makodza manji wa jamii ya tangawizi. Chinachofika dzikoni ni makakaya madide ga chijani ngushu-ngushu genye pembe tahu, na chila kakaya rina tembe nyinji ndide nyiru, zinazonyata, zenye arufu kali, ya mtswano na chidide dza ya ulimbo.

where.en: Cardamom is not grown on the south coast; it is imported and bought in markets and shops.
where.sw: Iliki haipandwi pwani ya kusini; huagizwa kutoka nje na kununuliwa sokoni na madukani.
where.dg: *Cardamom* tairimwa pwani ya kusini; nkurehwa kula tsi za kondze na nkugulwa cheteni na madukani.

uses.en: It flavours *mahamri*, the fried breakfast dough; *kashata*, the sweet of coconut, sugar and cardamom; and *mkate wa kumimina*, the poured rice-flour bread. It is also added to tea.
uses.sw: Hukoleza *mahamri*, maandazi ya kukaanga ya kifungua kinywa; *kashata*, peremende ya nazi, sukari na iliki; na *mkate wa kumimina*, mkate wa unga wa mchele unaomiminwa. Pia hutiwa kwenye chai.
uses.dg: Inapha ladha *mahamri*, unga wa kukalangwa wa chai ya ligundzu; *kashata*, chitu cha mtswano cha nazi, sukari na *cardamom*; na *mkate wa kumimina*, mkahe wa unga wa mtele unaomwagwa. Piya nkutiywa chai.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili calls it *iliki*. In English it is cardamom.
names.sw: Hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa bado. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *iliki*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *cardamom*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *iliki*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *cardamom*.

reason.en: Same family; ginger, another tea spice
reason.sw: Familia moja; tangawizi, kiungo kingine cha chai
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga; *tangawizi*, chitu chanjina chinachotiywa chai

reason.en: Another imported spice for tea and rice
reason.sw: Kiungo kingine kinachoagizwa kutoka nje kwa chai na wali
reason.dg: *Cinnamon*, chitu chanjina chinachorehwa kula kondze, cha chai na mtele

reason.sw: Kiungo kingine kinachoagizwa kutoka nje kwa chai
reason.dg: *Karafuu*, chitu chanjina chinachorehwa kula kondze, cha chai

reason.en: Coconut, the partner of cardamom in kashata
reason.sw: Nazi, mwenzi wa iliki katika kashata
reason.dg: *Mnazi*, ambao nazize nkutiywa phamwenga na *cardamom* kpwenye *kashata*

sources: Mwalonya, Nicolle, Nicolle & Zimbu, Mgombato: Digo-English-Swahili Dictionary (BTL / Digo Language and Literacy Project, 2004; e-version 2005)
